title: 皐月賞の後に・忍び寄る鬼

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The heated race comes to an end. Winning Ticket, having defeated Biwa Hayahide and Narita Taishin, reflects on her triumph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, she is worried about the growing threat of Taishin and her fierce sprinting ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shaking off her uneasiness, Ticket forces herself to focus squarely on the Japanese Derby, where she can't afford to lose.
